freeze_rule: AIFC v1.0 MUST NOT be labeled FROZEN unless every required check has machine-verifiable PASS evidence. v0.6 may establish direct Ed25519 mathematical validity against the key in the exact signing registry snapshot, but this MUST NOT be promoted to historical key safety: later compromise/revocation evidence must be replayed with an externally rooted effective uncertainty boundary, and external freshness must separately exclude valid stale histories. The legacy signature-profile compatibility allowance must still be removed before v1.0 FROZEN.
forbidden_shortcuts: treating successful Ed25519 verification as proof that the key was historically uncompromised
treating registry-local ACTIVE status as proof that no later evidence retroactively invalidates the receipt
treating a cryptographically valid stale receipt as fresh evidence
using a signature key not present and active in the exact signed registry snapshot
ignoring key validity interval at the receipt registry sequence
accepting an Ed25519 backend result without recording the backend identity in Verifier A output
defining or changing signature-preimage semantics after the first CREATED slot
treating a legacy receipt without signature_profile_id as strongest-grade evidence
signing an arbitrary JSON rendering instead of the frozen typed binary signature preimage
using an implementation-selected prehash when the frozen profile requires direct Ed25519
omitting receipt_schema from the signed message and permitting cross-receipt-type replay
omitting protocol_version, experiment_id, trial scope, logical position or transition role from the signed message
omitting content_schema, content_hash, registry_hash or registry_sequence from the signed message
omitting witness_id or key_id from the signed message
treating a signed wall-clock timestamp as freshness proof
accepting base64, mixed-case hex or non-exact Ed25519 key/signature lengths in strongest-grade v1
manual override of failed conformance gate
parsing JSON Schema source with duplicate-key last-key-wins semantics
treating a content-hash-valid object as protocol-valid without Draft 2020-12 runtime schema admission
claiming a CI PASS for a source tree not named by a proof-carrying verifier CI attestation
trusting declared CI exit_code without replaying separately hashed exit evidence bytes
trusting declared CI test_count without parsing the bound unittest report bytes
claiming a GitHub run/job/artifact existed without a post-upload platform receipt or equivalent independently checked platform evidence
reusing a green run after workflow, schema, verifier, checker or test-corpus source sets changed
reusing a green run after the execution environment changed without a newly bound environment manifest
using mutable GitHub Action major tags in the verifier self-audit workflow
installing verifier runtime dependencies without exact versions and required wheel hashes
interpreting process exit zero by itself as scientific admission or physical retrocausality
dropping attack vectors after observing failures
using one implementation twice as independent implementations
claiming canonical equivalence without byte-identical cross-implementation results
creating any trial before an externally certified frozen experiment plan exists
creating a trial outside a frozen schedule/trigger rule that the verifier cannot replay
using a terminal subtype impossible from the recorded source state
equating declared ledger coverage with complete publication before publication-manifest replay
starting candidate production before a certified CREATED slot
declaring K_i without resolving the frozen candidate set and candidate provenance
allowing post-CREATED operator generator choice for strongest-grade v1
reconstructing or sanitizing the conditioning view after target observation
trusting a producer-selected future event without deterministic selector replay
choosing or ambiguously encoding target transformation after target observation
selecting an entropy/security justification after observing the target
accepting dangling evidence hashes without exact-byte resolution
counting multiple witness IDs in one failure domain as independent quorum members
using a disconnected or unauthorized witness-registry transition
accepting noncanonical rational bounds
using the fixed-horizon product formula outside its frozen theorem conditions
placing a release manifest inside the source commit whose SHA it claims to bind
setting FROZEN_PASS without resolving every required gate evidence object
